component.name: WakaTime CLI
component.summary: Command line interface used by all WakaTime text editor plugins

description.p: WakaTime CLI collects and sends code activity metrics (time spent, files edited, languages used) from text editors and IDEs to the WakaTime API.
It is not normally invoked directly; instead it is called by one of the WakaTime plugins available for popular text editors and IDEs.
